name: Following Your Husband
overview: Scripture teaches that a wife’s role involves a respectful submission to her husband, reflecting the order established by God where the husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church (Ephesians 5:22-23). This submission is not a call to inferiority, but a voluntary, reverent yielding as unto the Lord, grounded in mutual submission out of reverence for God (Ephesians 5:21). The husband’s responsibility is to love his wife sacrificially, mirroring Christ’s love for the church (Ephesians 5:25, 28). The foundation of this relationship is seen from the beginning in Genesis 3:16, where the woman’s desire is directed toward her husband, who holds a leadership role within the marriage.
